read_problems: 9B pct (4) column shows "2.0339%" which appears swapped with pct2 "1.2845%" based on sequence pattern vs neighboring rows; transcribed as printed regardless.
Some annual tax figures (6b) truncated at right edge of image (e.g. "28,625.3", "36,701.1") - not transcribed as these are annual, not needed per instructions.

Bath counts printed as "3.5.5", "4.5.5", "5.5.5" (e.g. "3 BR / 3.5.5 BATHS") — unclear exact meaning; transcribed literally as printed rather than converting, since the half/half format is ambiguous (could be 3 full + 2 half, or OCR artifact of "3.5" baths with duplicate digit).
Tax columns (6) and (6b) are "w/421A" abatement figures, monthly and annual; no non-abatement tax column is printed on this page, so tax_m uses the w/421A monthly figure (col 6).

carry_m not explicitly printed as a distinct "total carrying charges" column; used column (5c) "Projected Total Monthly Common Charges" value for carry_m per closest match, but this does not include taxes — true carrying charge (common charges + taxes) is not printed as a single column.
